title: The globular cluster 47 Tuc
caption: The core of the globular cluster 47 Tucanae, imaged by ESO's Very Large Telescope
celestial: 47 Tucanae · constellation Tucana · about 15000 light-years away (source figure)

recognition.text: Official ESO press-release image. No published audience rating.

story: This image from ESO's Very Large Telescope zooms into the central core of 47 Tucanae, a globular cluster about 15,000 light-years away in the constellation Tucana. The frame is 7 arcminutes wide, yet the whole cluster spans about 30 arcminutes on the sky, so this is only its heart.
A globular cluster is a dense, roughly spherical ball of old stars held together by gravity. Their cores are crowded, so separating the individual stars there calls for a large telescope.

The data were taken with the FORS1 instrument on Kueyen, the second of the VLT's Unit Telescopes, through U and R filters and a narrow-band filter centered near 485 nm. The total exposure time was under 5 minutes. The observations were retrieved from the ESO Science Archive. Rubina Kotak processed them and Henri Boffin carried out the final image processing.
scale: Using the source's listed field of view (6.76 x 6.86 arcminutes) and distance (15000 light years), the frame spans roughly 29 × 30 light-years. Its light set out about 15,000 years before reaching the telescope.

understand.summary: This image comes from FORS1 on the VLT's Kueyen telescope, using a U filter at the ultraviolet end of the spectrum, a narrow-band filter near 485 nm and an R filter. The color assigned to each filter isn't published.
understand.eye: The U filter reaches into ultraviolet light the eye cannot see, and the telescope collects far more light than the eye can.

behind.exposure: Not published on the source page.
behind.technique: Not stated by the source (single frame, stack, mosaic or panorama unknown).

explore: North is at the top and east is to the left. Because the picture was built from observations already held in an archive, it shows how data gathered for one purpose can later be turned into a new image.
alt: The crowded central core of the globular cluster 47 Tucanae.
